title: Counting long words
description: count_long_words(words, min_length) should return how many words in the list have at least min_length characters. An empty list gives 0.

bug.summary: count = 0 is inside the loop, so the count is reset for every word, and an empty list never creates count at all.

tests.description: long words at the start and end
one long word at the end

hints.1: Think about what happens to a running count each time a loop goes round. Is anything erasing the progress made so far?
hints.2: Look at where `count = 0` sits, on line {line}. How many times does that line run for a list of three words?
hints.3: Because `count = 0` is inside the loop, the count goes back to zero for every word, so at most one word is ever counted, and an empty list never creates `count` at all. The counter should be set up once, not on every pass.
